pedidos.instruccion_en: Redo only the 4 day panels with the same woman (same face, slim build) and a clear, visible progression; every panel must have a different outfit, pose, hairstyle and setting. Day 1: thin straight legs, narrow flat hips, flat silhouette with no curve; loose light-blue mom jeans hanging flat, one hand pulling the waistband a fist away from her body to show the gap, oversized grey t-shirt, messy low bun, bedroom with mirror, cool dim light, frustrated look. Day 7: slightly more shaped; black straight trousers, white t-shirt, high ponytail, kitchen, warm daylight. Day 14: noticeably more shaped; dark fitted jeans, striped knit top, half-up hair, sunny balcony with plants, light smile. Day 21: the most shaped and defined silhouette, still natural; terracotta wrap midi dress, loose defined curls, bright living room, confident smile. Front or three-quarter front views, knees-up framing, never from behind, no close-up on body zones. Keep unchanged: headline, day labels, panel grid and borders, product, offer box, logo, palette and fonts.
pedidos.resumen: Cada día ahora tiene otra ropa, pose, peinado y lugar. El día 1 muestra piernas delgadas y caderas planas, y el cambio crece hasta el día 21.
